one_line: Commander of Alauddin Khalji’s southern tribute campaigns, 1307–1311 CE.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but battle-hardened, athletic build.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium warm-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, intense narrow eyes with a focused gaze, default expression calm and calculating with a slight confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair, medium length to just above shoulders, kept mostly hidden under a deep red quilted Turkic-style war cap with a soft rounded crown and short ear-covering flaps, a slim dark leather strap running under the chin.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved knee-length off-white cotton tunic (kurta) and loose off-white trousers gathered at the ankles, he wears a fitted chainmail shirt reaching mid-thigh with short sleeves and a dark steel sheen; above this sits a sleeveless dark emerald-green quilted cotton coat (farji) with vertical stitching and side slits, cinched by a broad brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle and a small pouch at his left hip; his forearms are protected by plain steel bracers over tight off-white cloth wraps, and his lower legs by brown leather boots rising to mid-calf with slightly turned-up toes; a deep indigo-blue cotton sash is wrapped once around his waist under the belt, with one end hanging slightly, and a matching indigo-blue lightweight cotton shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his back for travel, kept clear of his sword arm; minimal jewellery—a small plain silver ring on the right hand—keeps the look martial and practical.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Delhi-style cavalry sword with a simple steel blade, iron cross-guard, and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt with a rounded pommel, worn at his left hip in a plain dark leather scabbard; in hand he often rests it angled downward, ready but controlled.

ref_desc: Malik Kafur is a lean early-30s commander with an oval warm-brown face, medium black hair under a deep red war cap, chainmail and emerald-green quilted coat over off-white tunic and trousers, brown boots, indigo sash, and a curved Delhi cavalry sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Malik Kafur as a battle-hardened early-30s commander: lean athletic build, oval warm-brown face with sharp cheekbones, straight nose, short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and intense narrow eyes set in a calm, calculating expression with a slight confident half-smile. His medium-length straight black hair is mostly hidden beneath a deep red quilted Turkic-style war cap with a soft rounded crown, short ear-covering flaps, and a slim dark leather strap under the chin. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length off-white cotton tunic and loose off-white trousers gathered at the ankles, covered by a fitted chainmail shirt reaching mid-thigh with short sleeves and a dark steel sheen. Over the mail is a sleeveless dark emerald-green quilted cotton coat with vertical stitching, side slits, and a broad brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle and a small pouch at his left hip. His forearms have plain steel bracers over tight off-white cloth wraps, and his lower legs are in brown leather boots rising to mid-calf with slightly turned-up toes. An indigo-blue cotton sash is wrapped around his waist under the belt, one end hanging slightly, and a matching indigo-blue lightweight shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his back without obstructing his sword arm. He wears a small plain silver ring on his right hand. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved Delhi-style cavalry sword in a plain dark leather scabbard, with a simple steel blade, iron cross-guard, and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt with a rounded pommel; pose him holding the sword loosely in one hand, angled downward as if ready yet controlled. Use emerald green, deep red, indigo blue, off-white, steel grey, and brown leather as the dominant colors, keeping the design historically grounded, modest, and heroic.
